# Vendored STL viewer dependencies

Unmodified files from the official Three.js **r160** tag:
<https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160>

- `build/three.module.js`
- `examples/jsm/loaders/STLLoader.js`
- `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`
- `LICENSE` (MIT; preserve this notice with distribution)

Served locally through the dashboard import map. No CDN, Node installation or
network fetch is needed at application runtime. Update all modules together when
changing versions and rerun the preview browser check.
